messages:
Rae Thompson (recruiter): Heads-up: Arjun Malhotra (Backend candidate) requested same-day boarding pass reimbursement and access to a private lactation room during his onsite on 2026-06-10. Can people-ops confirm policy and logistics?
Marta Gomez (people ops): Policy wise we reimburse up to $75 for last-minute travel expenses. For lactation room, we have two private rooms on 3rd floor. @Benji can you reserve one and add a sign?
Benji (facilities): Reserved Lactation Room B (3rd floor) 09:00-17:00 on 2026-06-10. Will place a discreet sign at reception and provide a keycard. Also confirmed a refrigerator and comfy chair in the room.
recruiter-bot: Attached: /policies/travel-reimbursement.pdf :paperclip:  Reimbursement form link: https://intranet/redwood/forms/reimb
Arjun Malhotra (candidate): Thanks everyone. My flight was changed last-minute; I bought an electronic boarding pass for $62. Ill upload the receipt. Also appreciate the lactation room. Can interviews start at 11:30 due to pump schedule?
Rae Thompson (recruiter): 11:30 start is fine. I'll shift the calendar, add 20-min buffer for pump breaks, and note dietary preference (halal boxed lunch). Marta, please confirm reimbursement once receipt uploaded.
Marta Gomez (people ops): Confirmed. Reimbursement approved up to $75. Please upload boarding pass/receipt within 14 days to the form. Finance will process within two pay cycles. Closing loop after uploads. :white_check_mark:
notes: Short thread coordinating same-day boarding pass reimbursement, lactation room reservation, interview time adjustment, and catering note.
